name: Trouble Chaser Dai 1 Wa - Trouble wa Sora kara Mirai kara
original_name: トラぶるＣＨＡＳＥＲ 第１話 トラブルは空から未来から
source:
Daiskuke was playing video games when a spacecraft landed on his house demolishing half of it. A pretty girl came out of the ship saying that she came from the future to protect Daisuke who has an important role to play from time criminals.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大辅正在玩电子游戏，一艘宇宙飞船却突然降落在他家，把房子毁掉了一半。一名漂亮女孩从飞船里走出来，自称来自未来。她要保护大辅免遭时间罪犯伤害，因为他将在未来扮演重要角色。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
